title: Transfer: Scholarship Award Audit Workbook
goal: Finish a financial-aid workbook by reconciling student roster, grades, and bursar balance sheets, using lookup and aggregation formulas to determine award eligibility, identify mismatches, and fill the final scholarship disbursement review sheet.
skillBenefitRationale: This transfers the spreadsheet skill into an academic administration setting where cross-sheet lookups, formula integrity, and workbook preservation are the main challenge. No other shipped skill is needed beyond xlsx.
